title: Hello World
intro: Welcome to your very first lesson! Today we teach the computer to talk.

steps.text: The print() magic word makes the computer say things! Type: print("Hello!") and press Run.
Great! Now change the words inside the quotes and press Run again.
You can print lots of things at once! Try: print("Hi", "World")
You even draw with print! Try this cat face.

title: Name Boxes
intro: A box with a name — put a word or number inside, open it later!

steps.text: Watch the magic: name = "Ava" puts the word Ava in a box called name. Then print(name) opens the box!
Numbers don't need quotes. Try: age = 5, then print(age)
Make TWO boxes and print them together!

mission.brief: Make a box called hero AND a box called power, then print them.

title: Joining Words
intro: Glue words together to make funny sentences!

steps.text: The + sign glues words: "Hi " + name. Try it!
The comma puts a space in between: print("I love", "cats")
Build a birthday card!

mission.brief: Join your name with Hello using +

title: Making Choices
intro: Teach the computer to decide what to do!

steps.text: if checks something. Try: if score > 5: print("You win!")
Add an else for the other case!
Change the score and see what happens!

mission.brief: Make an if that prints 'win' when score is 10.

title: Loops
intro: Make the computer do things again and again!

steps.text: for star in range(5) means do it 5 times! Try it.
Make a unicorn parade!
steps.pre:
for i in range(6):
    print("🦄 Unicorn!")

steps.text: Count down from 5!

mission.brief: Print the word 'yay' three times with a loop.

title: Lists
intro: A list is a box that holds MANY things in order!

steps.text: Make a pet shop!
The first thing is pets[0]. Try pets[1] and pets[2]!
Loop through the list!

mission.brief: Make a list of 3 animals and print the first one.

title: Chat with Pixi
intro: The computer can ASK you questions!

steps.text: input() asks a question and waits for your answer.
steps.pre:
name = input("What's your name? ")
print("Hello,", name)

steps.text: Make Pixi say hi back!
steps.pre:
color = input("Favourite colour? ")
print("I love", color, "too!")

mission.brief: Use input() to ask a name, then print a greeting.

title: Magic Words
intro: Teach the computer a NEW magic word with def!

steps.text: def teaches the computer a new word!
Give your word an argument!
steps.pre:
def greet(who):
    print("Hello " + who + "!")

greet("Ava")
greet("Pixi")

mission.brief: Write a def and call it twice!
